questions.question: How should the cutover be sequenced?

options.label: Blue-green
options.description: Stand up a complete second environment, replay production traffic against it until the error budget holds for a full business day, then flip the load balancer in one move and keep the old fleet warm for the length of the rollback window

options.label: Rolling
options.description: Replace nodes a few at a time behind the existing load balancer, draining connections on each one before it goes, which keeps capacity roughly flat but means both schema versions are live against the same database for the whole window

options.label: Shadow first
options.description: Mirror a copy of live traffic to the new stack without serving any of its responses, compare them offline, and only start the real cutover once the diff rate has been under the threshold for several consecutive days

options.label: Saturday 02:00
options.description: Lowest traffic, no on-call overlap with the EU team

options.label: Tuesday 23:00
options.description: Full staffing, but overlaps the nightly billing run

questions.question: Describe the rollback trigger:
questions.placeholder: e.g. error rate above 2% for five minutes
